policy: fixed probe set, same k beams every frame, best measured one kept
objective: greedy minimization of mean dB power regret on the optimization rows
inputs_at_run_time: none: no radar, no position, no previous alignment
training_supervision: the full 64-beam power vector on the optimization rows, a richer target than the argmax label the readout is fitted to
cost_model: k * T_sec in both regimes, since there is no frame to acquire

selection_dedicated.tie_break: least validation mean regret, then fewest probes, then name
